name: singlet_dim_reduction_pc_number_selection
title: Choose number of principal components
description: Chooses how many leading principal components to keep for neighbour graphs, clustering and embeddings by testing the PCA spectrum of the highly variable gene matrix against a null. The default denoise_tech uses a technical-variance threshold from raw counts; alternatives are gavish_donoho, marchenko_pastur, horn, jackstraw, count_null, findpc and fixed. It needs uns/pca (or layers/log1p_norm) and var/highly_variable, plus layers/counts for denoise_tech and count_null, and writes uns/pc_selection/<method>/ members and uns/pc_selection/summary. Do not use it to set clustering resolution, to choose genes, to match a preferred number, or when the user fixed the number of components. jackstraw and count_null are slow, so run dry_run first on large datasets.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Rule that chooses k. denoise_tech is the provisional default; fixed returns max_pcs.

max_pcs.description: K: components considered and ceiling on k. findpc scans this many standard deviations. Recomputes the spectrum if uns/pca holds fewer values.

min_pcs.description: Floor on the emitted k; must not exceed max_pcs. k_raw is reported unclamped.

noise_var.description: Noise variance for gavish_donoho and marchenko_pastur, in variance units of the centred log values; 'estimate' uses the discarded-eigenvalue mean.

threshold.description: tau: a component is kept while the fraction of permuted eigenvalues at least as large is at most tau.

prop_freq.description: Fraction of features permuted in each replicate.

score_thresh.description: Gene-level empirical p-value threshold for counting significant features per component.

pc_alpha.description: Level of the component-level proportion test (a design choice).

replicates.description: B: simulated null matrices; alpha*(B+1) integer gives an exact test level.

model.description: Count model of the null; poisson sets the dispersion to zero.

alpha.description: Nominal level of the per-component test against the leading null eigenvalue.

seed.description: Random seed for horn, jackstraw, count_null and randomised decompositions; other methods are deterministic.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing members under uns/pc_selection/<method>/ instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/pc_selection/denoise_tech/k. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary: method, k, k_raw, min_pcs, max_pcs, n_cells, n_genes, spectrum_source, noise_var_used, clamped, warnings and the method's extra keys. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
